senses.gloss: m. (contr. of מהמון, v. הָמוֹן; הָמָה) accumulation, wealth, value (in Greek writers: Mammon). Tanḥ. Matt. 7 אתם חיבבתם את מָמוֹנְכֶם וכ׳ you loved your wealth (of cattle) more than your souls; Num. R. s. 12.
units: Ib.; Tanḥ. l. c. 6 מ̇מ̇ון̇ מ̇ה שאתה מ̇ונ̇ה אינו כלום money is named mamon, that which thou countest is nothing.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 2b:7">B. Mets. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ המוטל בספק</he> property of doubtful ownership (with several claimants).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:13">Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b:7">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>מחשבין לפי מ׳</he> the loss of a caravan attacked by robbers (the redemption paid them) is apportioned according to the value of the freight which each passenger carried, contrad. to <he>לפי נפשות</he> according to the number of passengers.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 83b:20">Ib. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>עין תחת עין מ׳</he> ‘eye for eye’ (<cite ref="Exodus 21:24">Ex. XXI, 24</cite>) means a fine in value, opp. <he>עין ממש</he> an actual putting out of the eye; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> (ed. Fr., p. 105ᵇ) <he>אין אתה עומד במימיו</he>, read <he>במָמוֹנוֹ</he>, thou canst not define its value; Fr. a. l. emends <he>בטִימְיוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="I00378"><he>טִימֵי</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>מָמוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:1">Snh. I, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00634"><he>דִּין</he></cite>; a. fr.
